name: diao-chan-idyll-corsage-enter-wither-and-flowerbud
notes: Idyll Corsage's own On Enter (enterAbilities["d7l6i5thdy:0"], GeneratedMacroCode.php ~10759 + customDQHandlers["d7l6i5thdy:0:Enter-1"] ~29923) is reached via a REAL level-up (same patchMzId + myMemory-seed technique as the Kongming Ascetic Vice precedent): the champion's CardID is patched to Diao Chan, Dreaming Wish (pknaxnn0xo, level 2), which satisfies CanChampionLevelUpIntoCard's targetLevel===currentLevel+1 gate (GameLogic.php ~20009-20023, no lineage-name check, just level+1), 3 filler cards are seeded into myMemory to pay Idyll Corsage's own 3-memory level-up cost, and myMaterial-0 (Idyll Corsage; Material reindexes to 0 once the pregame flow moves Spirit of Fire out to Field) is chosen as a real main-phase action, actually materializing her and firing her real On Enter. Player 2 keeps their default Level 0 champion (Spirit of Fire) and has an Unstable Fractal (PHANTASIA, non-token, non-champion) seeded onto their field as the wither target -- the On Enter's MZMULTICHOOSE decision (built by filtering CHAMPION-type objects out of both fields) is answered by selecting it. A SEPARATE plain item (ChannelTech Charm S, rR2j9dQRDH, NORM ITEM, non-regalia) is also seeded onto player 2's field and destroyed via Break Apart (4ns2jbt4hq, NORM ACTION, 'Destroy target item or weapon') played from player 1's hand -- a real non-attack removal spell, sidestepping Rule 1.h's first-player attack lock entirely. Break Apart's generated handler calls AllyDestroyed() -> DoAllyDestroyed() (ZoneAccessors.php / GameLogic.php), the shared destroy-event dispatcher that Idyll Corsage's 'whenever a non-token object an opponent controls is destroyed' trigger lives inside (GameLogic.php ~7976-7996). Destroying it this way correctly fires the trigger: player 1 (Idyll Corsage's controller) is offered a YESNO to banish the destroyed card and give its controller (player 2) a Flowerbud token; answering YES resolves customDQHandlers["DiaoChanIdyllBanish"] (CardDQHandlers.php ~5386), moving the item to player 2's banishment and summoning a Flowerbud token (yn78t73w1p, TOKEN,PHANTASIA) onto player 2's own field. Verified directly against the engine after replay: p1Field-0 is d7l6i5thdy; p2Field-1 (Unstable Fractal) has Counters {"wither":1}; p2Field-2 is a fresh yn78t73w1p (Flowerbud) token; p2Banish-0 is the destroyed rR2j9dQRDH. ENGINE BUG (found, not fixed, since it wasn't the only way to exercise this card): Disenchant (zd83net7x0, 'Destroy target phantasia') was tried FIRST as the destroy vehicle for this clause and does NOT fire this trigger (or the similarly-shaped Glimmer Essence Amulet 'whenever a phantasia you control is destroyed' trigger) at all -- its generated handler (GeneratedMacroCode.php customDQHandlers["zd83net7x0:0:CardActivated-1"], ~38040-38053) manually does OnLeaveField()+MZMove() straight to the graveyard, completely bypassing DoAllyDestroyed(), the shared destroy-event dispatcher that both of those 'whenever ... destroyed' triggers live inside. Any card whose printed text is exactly 'Destroy target X' should route through DoAllyDestroyed()/AllyDestroyed() the way Break Apart, Excalibur Cleansing Light, and Divine Comedy's cascade page 2 all correctly do; Disenchant (and potentially other similarly-generated 'Destroy target phantasia/ally/etc' abilities sharing this same code-generation template) silently skip every 'whenever this is destroyed' trigger on the target. Confirmed live: swapping this fixture's destroy vehicle from Disenchant to Break Apart is what made the Flowerbud/banish assertions observable at all. A second, minor, unrelated observation made along the way (not a bug, just noted for future fixture authors): seeding Business Card (lumV6cG9oc) directly onto a field via this tool's raw zone-seed queues a blocking interactive NAMECARD decision for that card's own On Enter, which silently stalls all subsequent actions in the fixture regardless of player -- avoid it (or any card with an interactive On Enter) as an inert filler object; ChannelTech Charm S's On Enter (a plain 'draw into memory') was used instead precisely because it resolves without any decision.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Choose any amount of non-champion objects and put a wither counter on each of them.
Whenever a non-token object an opponent controls is destroyed, you may banish it. If you do, that opponent summons a Flowerbud token.
